name: TruePeopleSearch
tip: Enter your email, tick the box, solve the CAPTCHA and tap Begin Removal. Then find your record, open it and tap Remove This Record. Finish with the link they email you.

name: Spokeo
tip: Paste your listing link, enter your email, solve the CAPTCHA and submit. Finish with the link they email you.

name: Whitepages
tip: This form confirms by phone call. To skip the call, email privacyrequest@whitepages.com with your name, city and listing link instead.

name: 411.com
tip: 411 uses the Whitepages removal form, so one Whitepages request covers both sites.

name: PeopleSearchNow
tip: Start on this page, not from your listing. Tick the boxes, enter your email, do the CAPTCHA and tap Opt Out My Info. Then search your name from that page, open your record and tap Remove Record. Finish with the link they email you.

name: USA People Search
tip: Start on this page, not from your listing. Complete it, then search your name from the page it gives you, tap view details on your record and remove it. Finish with the link they email you.

name: Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, US Search
tip: One request covers all four sites. Enter your email, tap the link they email you, enter your date of birth, then find your record and suppress it.

name: BeenVerified and PeopleLooker
tip: Search your name, pick your record, tap Proceed to Opt Out and enter your email. Finish with the link they email you.
